biggest_catch: Only GBC Bank Easy or On Campus Checking qualifies, and the $300-per-statement-cycle direct-deposit requirement must be met for three consecutive cycles within 90 days - a slow start kills the bonus.
catches: New GBC Bank Easy or On Campus Checking accounts only; offer not available to existing GBC Bank checking customers.
Not available to those whose GBC Bank accounts were closed within 90 days or closed with a negative balance within the last 3 years.
Receive qualifying direct deposits totaling $300 or more per statement cycle into the new checking account within 90 days of account opening (three consecutive cycles per the promotion steps).

Direct deposit must be an electronic deposit of paycheck, pension, or government benefits; person-to-person payments (e.g. Zelle), transfers from investment/brokerage accounts, self-transfers, and micro-deposits do not qualify.
Only one new checking account opening bonus every two years from account opening date; one bonus per account.
The account must remain open and unrestricted at payout.
Bonus is considered interest and will be reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
